record.bible_text: Elihu<WH0453> also proceeded<WH03254><WTH8686>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,

Suffer<WH03803><WTH8761> me a little<WH02191>, and I will shew<WH02331><WTH8762> thee that <FI>I have<Fi> yet to speak<WH04405> on God's<WH0433> behalf. <RF>I have...: Heb. there are yet words for God<Rf>
I will fetch<WH05375><WTH8799> my knowledge<WH01843> from afar<WH07350>, and will ascribe<WH05414><WTH8799> righteousness<WH06664> to my Maker<WH06466><WTH8802>.
For truly<WH0551> my words<WH04405> <FI>shall<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> false<WH08267>: he that is perfect<WH08549> in knowledge<WH01844> <FI>is<Fi> with thee.<CM>
Behold, God<WH0410> <FI>is<Fi> mighty<WH03524>, and despiseth<WH03988><WTH8799> not <FI>any: he is<Fi> mighty<WH03524> in strength<WH03581> <FI>and<Fi> wisdom<WH03820>. <RF>wisdom: Heb. heart<Rf>
He preserveth not the life<WH02421><WTH8762> of the wicked<WH07563>: but giveth<WH05414><WTH8799> right<WH04941> to the poor<WH06041>. <RF>poor: or, afflicted<Rf>

He withdraweth<WH01639><WTH8799> not his eyes<WH05869> from the righteous<WH06662>: but with kings<WH04428> <FI>are they<Fi> on the throne<WH03678>; yea, he doth establish<WH03427><WTH8686> them for ever<WH05331>, and they are exalted<WH01361><WTH8799>.
And if <FI>they be<Fi> bound<WH0631><WTH8803> in fetters<WH02131>, <FI>and<Fi> be holden<WH03920><WTH8735> in cords<WH02256> of affliction<WH06040>;
Then he sheweth<WH05046><WTH8686> them their work<WH06467>, and their transgressions<WH06588> that they have exceeded<WH01396><WTH8691>.
He openeth<WH01540><WTH8799> also their ear<WH0241> to discipline<WH04148>, and commandeth<WH0559><WTH8799> that they return<WH07725><WTH8799> from iniquity<WH0205>.
If they obey<WH08085><WTH8799> and serve<WH05647><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> , they shall spend<WH03615><WTH8762> their days<WH03117> in prosperity<WH02896>, and their years<WH08141> in pleasures<WH05273>.
But if they obey<WH08085><WTH8799> not, they shall perish<WH05674><WTH8799> by the sword<WH07973>, and they shall die<WH01478><WTH8799> without knowledge<WH01847>. <RF>perish: Heb. pass away<Rf>
But the hypocrites<WH02611> in heart<WH03820> heap up<WH07760><WTH8799> wrath<WH0639>: they cry<WH07768><WTH8762> not when he bindeth<WH0631><WTH8804> them.
They<WH05315> die<WH04191><WTH8799> in youth<WH05290>, and their life<WH02416> <FI>is<Fi> among the unclean<WH06945>. <RF>They...: Heb. Their soul dieth<Rf> <RF>unclean: or, sodomites<Rf><CM>
He delivereth<WH02502><WTH8762> the poor<WH06041> in his affliction<WH06040>, and openeth<WH01540><WTH8799> their ears<WH0241> in oppression<WH03906>. <RF>poor: or, afflicted<Rf>

Even so would he have removed<WH05496><WTH8689> thee out of the strait<WH06310><WH06862> <FI>into<Fi> a broad place<WH07338>, where<WH08478> <FI>there is<Fi> no straitness<WH04164>; and that which should be set<WH05183> on thy table<WH07979> <FI> should be<Fi> full<WH04390><WTH8804> of fatness<WH01880>. <RF>that...: Heb. the rest of thy table<Rf>

But thou hast fulfilled<WH04390><WTH8804> the judgment<WH01779> of the wicked<WH07563>: judgment<WH01779> and justice<WH04941> take hold<WH08551><WTH8799> <FI>on thee<Fi> . <RF>take...: or, should uphold thee<Rf>

Because <FI>there is<Fi> wrath<WH02534>, <FI>beware<Fi> lest he take thee away<WH05496><WTH8686> with <FI>his<Fi> stroke<WH05607>: then a great<WH07230> ransom<WH03724> cannot deliver<WH05186><WTH8686> thee. <RF>deliver...: Heb. turn thee aside<Rf>
Will he esteem<WH06186><WTH8799> thy riches<WH07769>? <FI>no<Fi> , not gold<WH01222>, nor all the forces<WH03981> of strength<WH03581>.
Desire<WH07602><WTH8799> not the night<WH03915>, when people<WH05971> are cut off<WH05927><WTH8800> in their place.
Take heed<WH08104><WTH8734>, regard<WH06437><WTH8799> not iniquity<WH0205>: for this hast thou chosen<WH0977><WTH8804> rather than affliction<WH06040>.
Behold, God<WH0410> exalteth<WH07682><WTH8686> by his power<WH03581>: who teacheth<WH03384><WTH8688> like him?
Who hath enjoined<WH06485><WTH8804> him his way<WH01870>? or who can say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Thou hast wrought<WH06466><WTH8804> iniquity<WH05766>?<CM>
Remember<WH02142><WTH8798> that thou magnify<WH07679><WTH8686> his work<WH06467>, which men<WH0582> behold<WH07891><WTH8790>.
Every man<WH0120> may see<WH02372><WTH8804> it; man<WH0582> may behold<WH05027><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> afar off<WH07350>.
Behold, God<WH0410> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH07689>, and we know<WH03045><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> not, neither can the number<WH04557> of his years<WH08141> be searched out<WH02714>.
For he maketh small<WH01639><WTH8762> the drops<WH05198> of water<WH04325>: they pour down<WH02212><WTH8799> rain<WH04306> according to the vapour<WH0108> thereof:
Which the clouds<WH07834> do drop<WH05140><WTH8799> <FI>and<Fi> distil<WH07491><WTH8799> upon man<WH0120> abundantly<WH07227>.
Also can <FI>any<Fi> understand<WH0995><WTH8799> the spreadings<WH04666> of the clouds<WH05645>, <FI>or<Fi> the noise<WH08663> of his tabernacle<WH05521>?
Behold, he spreadeth<WH06566><WTH8804> his light<WH0216> upon it, and covereth<WH03680><WTH8765> the bottom<WH08328> of the sea<WH03220>. <RF>bottom: Heb. roots<Rf>
For by them judgeth<WH01777><WTH8799> he the people<WH05971>; he giveth<WH05414><WTH8799> meat<WH0400> in abundance<WH04342><WTH8688>.
With clouds<WH03709> he covereth<WH03680><WTH8765> the light<WH0216>; and commandeth<WH06680><WTH8762> it <FI>not to shine<Fi> by <FI>the cloud<Fi> that cometh betwixt<WH06293><WTH8688>.
The noise<WH07452> thereof sheweth<WH05046><WTH8686> concerning it, the cattle<WH04735> also concerning the vapour<WH05927><WTH8802>. <RF>the vapour: Heb. that which goeth up<Rf><CM>
